n-k-k7-02.title: Hal waqti saddex jadwal
n-k-k7-02.topic: Is-khilaafka waqtiga ee wada hadal qorshe
n-k-k7-02.goal: U beddel helitaanka saddex qof oo qayb ahaan qarsoon shuruudo sax ah, dhis dhawr waqti kulan oo buuxiya dhammaantood, oo arag sida hal isbeddel u beddelo doorashooyinka.
n-k-k7-02.material:
Saddex saaxiib fasal ayaa qorsheeya hal kulan waxbarasho usbuucan. Kulanku wuxuu qaadanayaa laba saacadood.

민수: 이번 주에 스터디를 한 번 하면 어때요? 두 시간쯤 걸려요.
지연: 저는 월요일은 아르바이트가 있어서 안 돼요. 다른 날은 오후 4시부터 괜찮아요.
민수: 저는 수요일은 안 돼요. 그리고 화요일 말고는 수업이 6시에 끝나서 6시 이후에만 가능해요.
수진: 저는 금요일은 안 돼요. 그리고 9시까지는 모임이 끝나야 해요.

(Dhammaan waqtiyadu waa p.m. haddii waqtiga aan la yidhi wax kale. '6시 이후' wuxuu ku jiraa saacadda 6, '9시까지 끝나야 해요' wuxuu oggol yahay kulanka inuu dhammaado sax 9.)
n-k-k7-02.thinking.1: Akhrinta ka reebanaan ('marka laga reebo Salaasada')
n-k-k7-02.thinking.2: Helitaanka in ka badan hal xal iyo saadaalinta isbeddel
n-k-k7-02.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan magacyada maalmaha usbuuca iyo waqtiyada saacadda
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.prompt: Maxay 민수 ka jeedaa '화요일 말고는 수업이 6시에 끝나서 6시 이후에만 가능해요'?
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.hint.0: Hel erayga kala saaraya Salaasada maalmaha kale, oo weydii maxuu ka qaadayaa Salaasada.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.hint.1: Weedha ku dheh erayadaada laba jeer: mar Salaasada mar-na maalmaha kale.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.a: Wuxuu kulmi karaa Salaasada oo keliya, weligii maalmaha kale ma kulmi karo.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.r.a: '말고는' wuxuu Salaasada ka kala saaraa maalmaha kale; ma sheego in Salaasadu tahay maalinta keliya.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.b: Wuxuu kulmi karaa maalin kasta kadib 6, laakiin Salaasada ma kahor 6.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.r.b: Haddii Salaasadu la mid ahaan lahayd maalmaha kale, sabab looma lahayn in si gooni ah loo sheego.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.c: Salaasada xad noocaas ah ma leh; maalmaha kale kadib 6 oo keliya.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.d: Fasalladiisu waxay dhammaadaan 6 maalin kasta, oo ay ku jirto Salaasada.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.r.d: Markaas '화요일 말고는' macno ma samaynayso; Salaasadu waa ka reebitaanka.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.explain: 'A 말고는 B' macnaheedu waa 'marka laga reebo A, B'. Maalin kasta marka laga reebo Salaasada xadka kadib-6 wuu khuseeyaa; Salaasadu waa ka reebitaanka. (Arbacada waxaa meesha ka saaray weedhiisii hore.)
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.prompt: Hel 3 waqti oo kala duwan oo qof walba ku habboon. d = lambarka maalinta usbuuca (1 = Isniin ... 5 = Jimce), h = waqtiga bilowga saacado dhan oo saacad 24 ah (tusaale 16 waxay ula jeedaa 4 p.m.). Kulanku wuxuu socdaa laba saacadood.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore ka tir maalmaha cidna imaan karin, kadibna go'aami waqtiga bilowga ugu hore iyo ugu dambeeya maalin kasta oo hadhay.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.hint.1: Waqtiga dhammaadku waa waqtiga bilowga oo lagu daray laba saacadood; ugu dambayntii la barbar dhig xadka 수진.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.ok.c0: Lambar maalin usbuuc ah oo 1 ilaa 5 ah iyo saacad dhan.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c0: Isticmaal lambar maalin usbuuc dhan oo 1 ilaa 5 ah iyo saacad bilow oo dhan.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c1: 지연 Isniinta waxay leedahay shaqo qeyb-waqti ah.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.ok.c2: 지연 waa bannaan laga bilaabo 4 p.m.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c2: 지연 waa bannaan 4 p.m. oo keliya.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.ok.c4: Xadka fasalka 민수 waa la ilaaliyay.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Marka laga reebo Salaasada, 민수 wuxuu kulmi karaa kadib 6 p.m. oo keliya.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.ok.c6: Kulanku wuxuu dhammaadaa 9 p.m. ugu dambayn.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c6: Kulanku wuxuu socdaa laba saacadood oo waa inuu dhammaado 9 p.m. ugu dambayn.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.explain: Kadib saddexda xad ee maalmaha, Salaasada iyo Khamiista oo keliya ayaa hadhay. Salaasada bilow kasta laga bilaabo 4 p.m. ilaa 7 p.m. wuu shaqeeyaa; Khamiista bilowgu waa inuu ahaadaa 6 ama 7 p.m. (dhammaadku wuxuu noqonayaa 9 ugu dambayn).
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Dooro HAL mid ka mid ah waqtiyadaada oo ku soo jeedi kooxda sheekaysiga Kuuriyaan (edeb -요): dheh maalinta usbuuca iyo waqtiga bilowga.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Qaado hal saf oo kor ah oo dheh maalinteeda iyo waqtigeeda Kuuriyaan.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ku dar dhammaad su'aal sida -어때요? ama soo jeedin fudud oo -해요.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma maalinta iyo waqtiga aan qoray waxay waafaqsan yihiin mid ka mid ah waqtiyada aan dhisay?
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma hubiyay in xadka cidna aan la jebin?
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.2: Wuxuu xuseyaa maalin la reebay si loo meesha ka saaro oo keliya; tani waa fiican tahay.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.prompt: Hadda 수진 waxay beddeshaa maskaxdeeda: '금요일도 괜찮아요. 대신 8시까지는 끝나야 해요.' Labada kale ma beddelmaan. Maxaa ku dhaca waqtiyada suurtagalka ah?
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.hint.0: Dib u samee shuruudaha xeerka cusub: bilowga ugu dambeeya hadda waa kuma haddii kulanku dhammaado 8?
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.hint.1: Jimcaha hubi qof walba mar mar, kadibna isbarbar dhig liisaska Salaasada iyo Khamiista kuwii hore.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.a: Jimcaha 6 p.m. ayaa furmaya, bilowyada daahsan ee Salaasada iyo Khamiista way yaraadaan.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.b: Waxba cusub ma furmaan, sababtoo ah 민수 weli ma kulmi karo Jimcaha.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.r.b: 민수 wuxuu meesha ka saaray Arbacada, ma aha Jimcaha.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.c: Jimcuhu wuu furmaa laga bilaabo 4 p.m., sida Salaasada.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.r.c: Jimcuhu ma aha Salaasada: 민수 wuxuu kulmi karaa Jimcaha kadib 6 p.m. oo keliya.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.d: Jimcuhu wuu furmaa, waqtiyada Khamiistuna waxay sii ahaanayaan sidii hore.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.r.d: Waqtiga dhammaadka ee hore wuxuu jaraa bilowga ugu dambeeya maalin kasta, oo ay ku jirto Khamiista.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.explain: Xeerka cusubi waa: ku dhammaad 8 p.m., sidaa darteed bilowgu waa ugu badnaan 6 p.m. Jimcuhu hadda wuxuu u baahan yahay bilow saxda ah ee 6 p.m. (민수 wuxuu u baahan yahay 6 ama ka dambeeya, 수진 hadda wuxuu u baahan yahay 6 ama ka hore). Salaasadu waxay lumisaa 7 p.m. Khamiistuna waxay haysataa 6 p.m. oo keliya.

n-k-k7-01.title: Keenid bilaash ah, yaa loogu talagalay?
n-k-k7-01.topic: Shuruudo qarsoon oo ku jira ogeysiis dukaan
n-k-k7-01.goal: Tijaabi sheegashooyinka dhawr iibsade iyadoo la eegayo ogeysiis keenid, hel sheegashooyinka ogeysiisku aanu taageerin, oo saaxiib uga digtoonow waxa uu hubiyo.
n-k-k7-01.material:
Saaxiib ayaa onlayn wax iibsanaya wuxuuna kuu muujinayaa ogeysiiska keenidda dukaanka. Dhawr iibsade ayaa yidhi waxa ay u malaynayaan inuu ka dhigan yahay.

[배송 안내]
1. 구매 금액이 30,000원 이상이면 배송비는 무료입니다. 단, 쿠폰으로 할인을 받으신 경우에는 할인된 금액을 기준으로 합니다.
2. 제주도와 섬 지역은 배송비 3,000원이 추가됩니다.
3. 오후 2시 이전에 결제하시면 당일에 출고됩니다.
n-k-k7-01.thinking.1: Hubinta sheegasho iyadoo la eegayo erayada sax ah ee cadaynta
n-k-k7-01.prereq.0: Wuxuu akhrin karaa ogeysiis gaaban oo leh tirooyin iyo 원
n-k-k7-01.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan -이면, -(으)ㄴ 경우, 이상 iyo 이전
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.prompt: Afar iibsade mid walba wuxuu iibsaday hal shay. Iibsadee ayaa hubaal ah inaysan bixin khidmad keenid oo dhan?
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ha is barbar dhigin qiimaha liiska iyo 30,000 isla markiiba. Dhex gudub weedh kasta oo lambar leh ee ogeysiiska oo qor wax kasta oo beddela qadarka la is barbar dhigayo ama ku daraya kharash.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.hint.1: Iibsade kasta, xisaabi qadarka la tirinayo, oo liis garee wax kasta oo kale oo ogeysiiska ku jira oo laga yaabo inuu quseeyo iibsadahaas.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.o.a: 소라 (Seoul): qiimaha liiska 33,000원, wuxuu isticmaalay coupon 5,000원
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.a: Coupon-ku wuxuu hoos u dhigaa qadarka la tirinayo. 33,000 - 5,000 = 28,000, taasoo ka yar 30,000.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.o.b: 준호 (Jeju Island): qiimaha liiska 40,000원, coupon la'aan
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.b: Qadarkiisu waa ku filan yahay, laakiin ogeysiisku wuxuu ku daraa kharash gooni ah gobolkiisa, sidaas darteed weli wax ayuu bixiyaa.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.o.c: 민지 (Seoul): qiimaha liiska 36,000원, wuxuu isticmaalay coupon 5,000원
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.d: 29,000 wuu ka hooseeyaa 30,000 shuruud midna ma beddesho taas.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.explain: 민지 wuxuu bixiyaa 36,000 - 5,000 = 31,000원, taasoo ah 30,000 ama ka badan, Seoul-na kharash dheeraad ah ma laha. Qadarka 소라 ka dib coupon waa 28,000. 준호 wuxuu helaa keenid aasaasi ah oo bilaash ah laakiin ogeysiisku wuxuu ku daraa 3,000원 Jeju. 태민 wuxuu ka hooseeyaa xadka.
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.prompt: Iibsadayaashu waxay ka hadlaan waxa ay iibsadeen. Dooro hal sadar oo sheegashadiisa aan ogeysiisku taageerin (waxaa laga yaabaa in ka badan hal sadar oo sidaas ah; mid kasta wuu tirsanayaa).
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sadar kasta, dib u xisaabi qadarka dukaanku isticmaali lahaa, kadibna hubi waqtiga ama gobolka haddii sadarku sheego.
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.hint.1: Eeg erayada lambarka ee ogeysiiska: kuwee ayaa dejiya xad, jihada xadkana waa la oggol yahay?
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.explain: Sadarrada 2 iyo 4 lama taageero. Sadarka 2: 32,000 - 4,000 = 28,000, xadka ka hooseeya. Sadarka 4: keenid maalintaas waxay u baahan tahay lacag bixin ka hor 2 p.m. Sadarka 1 waa fiican yahay (31,000, coupon la'aan), sadarka 3 wuxuu la jaanqaadaa kharashka Jeju, sadarka 5-na waa 30,000 sax ah, taasoo loo tiriyo '이상'.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.prompt: Saaxiib 제주도 jooga ayaa ku weydiisa: '3만 원 넘게 사면 무료배송이지?' Ku jawaab 1-2 weedhood oo Kuuriyaan ah (edeb -요 waa fiican yahay; dhawr eray oo Ingiriis ah waa la dulqaadan karaa) oo u sheeg labada shay ee ogeysiiska ee ay tahay inay hubiso ka hor intaysan filanin keenid bilaash ah.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.hint.0: Mar kale akhri weedh kasta oo lambar leh ee ogeysiiska oo weydii kee ayaa beddeli kara waxa saaxiibkaa bixiyo.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.hint.1: Marka hore qor jawaabta su'aasheeda, kadibna ku dar labada shuruudood adigoo isticmaalaya 그런데 ama 그리고.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sheegay labadaba: gobolkeeda iyo qiimo dhimista?
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma jawaabtaydu waxay saxaysaa aaminaadkeeda halkii ay celin lahayd qaanuunka?
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Qaab caadi ah, sidoo kale waa fiican yahay saaxiib dhow.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.model.2: Maadaama aad ku nooshahay 제주도, waxaa jira 3,000원 oo dheeraad ah, haddii aad isticmaasho 쿠폰 qiimaha la dhimay ayaa la tirinayaa.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Jawaab Ingiriis iyo Kuuriyaan isku jira weli waxay dhaafaysaa hubinta dusha sare.

n-k-k7-03.title: Halkee dib-u-eegistu ku dhacdaa?
n-k-k7-03.topic: Miisaaminta dib-u-eegis leh qaybo wanaagsan iyo kuwo xun
n-k-k7-03.goal: Dib u eeg akhrintaada dib-u-eegis makhaayad marka qayb kasta timaado, ogow weedha sida qoraagu qaado, oo qor talo ilaalisa labada dhinac.
n-k-k7-03.material: Arday ayaa qoray dib-u-eegis internet ah oo makhaayad ku dhow jaamacadda. Saaxiibkaa wuxuu rabaa inuu halkaas wax ku barto afar saacadood Sabtida. Dib-u-eegista waxaad akhrinaysaa qayb-qayb. (일부러 = ulajeeddo ku samee, 콘센트 = godka koronto, -(으)ㄹ 만하다 = mudan in la sameeyo)
n-k-k7-03.thinking.1: Arkidda qaybta weedha ee qaadata aragtida
n-k-k7-03.thinking.2: Soo koobid iyadoo aan dhinac la tuurin
n-k-k7-03.prereq.1: Wuxuu akhriyi karaa dib-u-eegis blog gaaban
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.prompt: Akhri qayb kasta, dooro jawaabta u muuqata mid ugu macquulsan, kadibna sii wad.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.hint.0: Go'aamin adigoo isticmaalaya qaybta aad ilaa hadda akhriday oo keliya.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.hint.1: Qayb kasta eeg weedha qoraagu u muuqdo inuu ugu daryeelo.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Maxay u badan tahay inuu qoraagu ku yiraahdo saaxiib raadinaya meel wax lagu barto?
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ilaa hadda waxaa jira ammaan oo keliya, sidaa darteed ku talagelidda waa dabiici. Akhriste taxadar leh weli wuxuu sugi karaa faahfaahin dheeraad ah.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: U tag; waa meel fiican oo wax lagu barto.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ha tagin; aad ayay u kacsan tahay.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Qoraagu wuxuu leeyahay muusiggu waa 조용해서, taasoo macnaheedu yahay aamusan.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: U tag haddii aad jeceshahay dadka badan oo keliya.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad tagto, laakiin marka hore hubi faahfaahinta.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Hadda maxuu qoraagu ku odhan lahaa saaxiib rabo inuu halkaas wax ku barto galab dhan?
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Qaybta dhibaatadu waxay ku saabsan tahay joogitaan dheer: godad koronto yar, kuraas adag. Ammaanta weli way run tahay, laakiin taladu waxay ku xidhan tahay intaad joogto.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: U tag; waa meesha ugu fiican barasho dheer.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kadib 하지만 qoraagu wuxuu magacaabaa dhibaatooyin muhiim u ah fadhiga muddo dheer.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Qoraagu weli wuu ammaanay meesha; cabashadu waxay ku saabsan tahay fadhiga muddo dheer.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Raadi meel kale oo barasho dheer; tani waxay ka fiican tahay joogitaan gaaban.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: U tag barasho dheer, laakiin keen charger-kaaga.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Dib-u-eegistu waxay leedahay fadhiga muddo dheer waa adag yahay; charger ma saxi lahayn kuraasta.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Weedhee ayaa dib-u-eegista oo dhan sida ugu caddaalad badan u sharaxaysa?
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Dhammaadku wuxuu celiyaa ammaanta laakiin wuxuu ku xidhaa shuruud: hal ama laba saacadood. Soo koobid caddaalad ah waxay ilaaliyaa ammaanta iyo xadka.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Makhaayad qodobkeeda ugu muhiimsan yahay dhibaatooyinkeeda, ammaantuna waa la xuseyaa oo keliya sida marinba.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Weedha ugu dambaysa waxay leedahay waxay mudan tahay safar gaar ah oo akhris gaaban, sidaa darteed ammaantu ma aha qodob dhinac ah.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Makhaayad quruxsan, aamusan oo mudan in la booqdo joogitaan akhris gaaban, ma aha mid dheer.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Makhaayad ku habboon nooc kasta oo waxbarasho ah.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Qaybta labaad waxay magacaabaysaa xadad dhab ah oo loogu talagalay fadhiyo dhaadheer.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Makhaayad ku habboon fadhi afar-saacadood ah inkasta oo kuraasta.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Qoraagu wuxuu leeyahay fadhiga muddo dheer waa adag yahay, sidaa darteed tani way ka soo horjeedda dib-u-eegista.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.reflect: Ogow sida taladaadu u isbeddeshay. Weedha ka dambeysa 하지만 iyo 그래도 badanaa waxay muujisaa waxa qoraagu rabo inaad xusuusato, soo koobid caddaalad ahna waa inay isku ilaalisaa ammaanta koowaad iyo xadka dambe oo ay la socoto shuruudda (intaad joogto).
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.prompt: Saaxiibkaa wuxuu qorsheynayaa afar saacadood oo barasho ah halkaas Sabtida. U sheeg Kuuriyaan (qaab edeb leh ama caadi ah) waxa aad ku talin lahayd, adigoo isticmaalaya waxa dib-u-eegistu leedahay.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.hint.0: Ku bilow qaybta dib-u-eegista ee ugu muhiimsan afar saacadood.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ku dar hal weedh oo gaaban oo ku saabsan waxa meeshu ku fiican tahay.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma taladaydu waxay ku xidhan tahay intay joogi doonto?
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma ilaaliyay dhinaca wanaagsan ee dib-u-eegista iyo dhibaatadaba?
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.model.2: Afar saacadood waxaan dooran lahaa meel kale: 의자 waa adag yihiin 콘센트 na ku dhawaad ma jiro. Waa fiican tahay hal saacad oo akhris ah.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.modelNote.2: Isku-darka luuqado weli wuxuu dhaafaa hubinta dusha sare.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.modelNote.3: Wuxuu bixiyaa gunaanadka dib-u-eegista (joogitaan gaaban oo keliya) halkii uu ka magacaabi lahaa kuraasta.

n-k-k7-04.title: Maxay dukaanku u baahan tahay inay ogaato?
n-k-k7-04.goal: Go'aami macluumaadka fariinta cabashada ee ugu horreysa ay u baahan tahay, dooro codsiga aan la khaldi karin, oo qor fariinta.
n-k-k7-04.material: Waxaad internet ku dalbatay jaakad. Waxaad dalbatay cabbirka L laakiin shalay waxaa timid jaakad cabbirka M ah, mana xidhi kartid. Waxaad u dirtaa fariin koowaad xarunta macmiilka ee dukaanka (고객센터) qoraal ahaan. Shaqaaluhu ma ku aqoon wuxuuna ku jawaabaa kadib marka uu akhriyo fariintaada oo keliya.
n-k-k7-04.thinking.2: Qorista akhriste aan dib u weydiin karin
n-k-k7-04.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan codsiyada edebta ah ee -(으)ㅂ니다/-어요
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.prompt: Macluumaadkee ayaa fariintaada koowaad ay tahay inay ka kooban tahay si dukaanku u xalliyo dhibaatada isagoo aan dib kuu qorin? Dooro dhammaan kuwa khuseeya.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ka fikir inaad tahay shaqaalaha: xaqiiqooyinkee ayaad u baahan lahayd inaad weydiiso kahor intaadan wax sameyn karin?
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ka tir waxa dukaanku horeyba haysto ama waxa aan beddelin waxa ay xiga sameeyaan.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.o.a: Raalli-galin gaaban oo ku saabsan dhibka shaqaalaha
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.a: Edeb waa fiican yahay, laakiin raalli-galinta macluumaad ma aha mid dukaanku ku fal-geli karo.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.c: Dukaanku horeyba wuxuu cinwaanka ka heystaa dalabka, lambarka dalabkuna wuxuu u saamaxayaa inay helaan.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.o.d: Shayga timid iyo waxa ku khaldan
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.o.e: Haddii aad rabto is-weydaarsi mise lacag celin
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.f: Daahitaanku halkan dhibaatada ma aha; cabbirka khaldan ayaa ah.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.explain: Dukaanku waa inuu awoodaa inuu helo dalabka (lambarka dalabka), fahmo waxa khaldamay (shayga iyo cabbirka), oo ogaado waxa aad rabto in la sameeyo (is-weydaarsi ama lacag celin). Raalli-galinta, cinwaankaaga iyo waqtiga gaarsiintu ma caawiyaan inay ficil gasho.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.prompt: Weedhee codsi ah ayaa dukaanka u sheegaysa si sax ah waxa uu sameeyo?
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.hint.0: Weedh kasta weydii maxay shaqaaluhu weli la yaabi karaan kadib markii ay akhriyaan.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.hint.1: Codsi fiican wuxuu ka jawaabaa 'maxaa la sameeyo, si loo helo maxay?'
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.r.a: Tani waxay ula jeedi kartaa cabbir kale, midab kale ama jaakad kale; dukaanku ma kala saari karo.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.r.b: Wuxuu leeyahay sida degdegga ah, ma aha waxa la sameeyo.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.r.c: Wuxuu doorashada gabi ahaanba u daayaa dukaanka.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.explain: 'L 사이즈로 교환해 주세요' wuxuu magacaabaa ficilka (교환) iyo natiijada (cabbirka L). Codsiyada kale waxay dukaanka ka tagaan inuu male-awaalo waxa aad rabto.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.prompt: Qor fariintaada 고객센터 Kuuriyaan (heer edeb ama rasmi ah, 2-4 weedhood). Ku soo kicin lambar dalab.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.hint.0: Ku fur salaan iyo hal weedh yar oo sababta aad u qorayso.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.hint.1: Kadibna saddexda xaqiiqo si nidaamsan u dhig: dalabkee, maxay khaldan tahay, maxaad rabto.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma shaqaaluhu ku fal-geli karaa fariintayda isagoo aan dib u qorin?
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma codsigaygu wuu cad yahay waxa aan rabo?
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ka gaaban, edeb -요; weli wuxuu ka kooban yahay saddexda xaqiiqo ee loo baahan yahay.

n-k-k7-05.title: Qof walba? Qof walba maaha
n-k-k7-05.topic: Tusaalayaal lid ku ah iyo diidmo qayb ah
n-k-k7-05.goal: Kala sooc 'qof walba maaha' iyo 'cidna', dooro caddayn runtii jebisa sheegasho 'qof walba', oo qor sheegasho adiga leh iyo tusaale lid ku ah oo edeb leh.
n-k-k7-05.material: Is-weydaarsi luuqadeed, marti ayaa leh: "한국 사람은 모두 매운 음식을 좋아해요." Adiga iyo fasal-wadaagyadaadu waxaad rabtaan inaad si edeb leh oo sax ah ugu jawaabtaan.
n-k-k7-05.thinking.2: Saxidda sheegasho iyadoo aan xad-dhaaf lagu sixin
n-k-k7-05.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan 모두, 다, 항상 iyo -지 않다
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.prompt: Toban saaxiib oo Kuuriyaan ah oo aad taqaan, shan ayaa jecel cunto qaraar ah shan na ma jecla. Bayaankee ayaa run ah?
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tiri imisa ka mid ah tobanka ayaa weedh kasta ku saabsan tahay.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.hint.1: Weydii haddii weedhu weli oggolaato shanta jecel.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.r.a: Taasi waxay macnaheedu noqon lahayd dhammaan tobanka ma jecla.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.r.c: Shan ka mid ah way jecelyihiin, sidaa darteed 'cidna' waa been.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.r.d: Taasi waxay macnaheedu noqon lahayd dhammaan tobanka way jecelyihiin.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.explain: '모두 ...는 것은 아니에요' wuxuu leeyahay 'qof walba' ma aha run, laakiin weli wuxuu oggolaanayaa inay dad qaar jecelyihiin. 'Cidna' waxay noqon lahayd sheegasho ka xoog badan waxa xaqiiqooyinku taageeraan.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.prompt: Hal caddayn kee ah ayaa ku filan in lagu muujiyo in '한국 사람은 모두 매운 음식을 좋아해요' khaldan yahay?
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.hint.0: Sheegashadu waxay ku saabsan tahay dhammaan dadka Kuuriyaanka iyo jeclaanshaha. Weydii waxa doorasho kasta ka sheegto jeclaanshaha, iyo yaa.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.hint.1: Doorasho kasta tijaabi: ma weli run noqon lahayd haddii sheegashadu run tahay?
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.r.a: Tani waa qof jecel cunto xoogga leh, taas oo la jaan qaadaysa sheegashada.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.r.b: Cunto badan oo xoog leh ayaa jira, laakiin taasi waxba ma sheegto in qof walba jeclaado.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.r.c: In la jeclaado cunto xoog leh oo la cuno naadir ma jebiso sheegashada, sababtoo ah sheegashadu waxay ku saabsan tahay jeclaanshaha.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.explain: Sheegasho ku saabsan qof walba waxaa jebin kara hal qof aan ku habboonayn. 민아 waa Kuuriyaan aan jeclayn cunto xoog leh. Uma baahnid inaad muujiso in inta badan dadku ka naceen.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.prompt: Samee lammaane khaduyaasha adiga u gaar ah af Kuuriyaan (edeb leh). A wuxuu sheegaa wax aad u xoog badan oo ku saabsan koox, isagoo isticmaalaya eray sida 모두, 다 ama 항상 (tusaale ahaan ardayda, magaalo ama cunto). B wuxuu si edeb leh ugu jawaabaa tusaale gaar ah oo lid ku ah wuxuuna yiraahdaa ma aha run qof walba.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.hint.0: Dooro koox aad si fiican u taqaanno, kadibna qor weedhda A oo leh hal eray 'dhammaan / had iyo jeer'.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.hint.1: B, ka fikir hal qof ama xaalad dhab ah oo aan ku habboonayn, oo dheh 'ma aha qof walba' halkii 'qofna'.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sheegashada A runtii waxay ku saabsan tahay qof walba, si hal tusaale u jebiyo?
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma jawaabta B waxay xoog u egtahay sida tusaalaha, ma aha mid ka xoog badan?
